## Summary

SigmaStar describes itself as a fabless design house and supplier of
vision AI SoCs, deployed in smart security, AIoT and smart automotive
devices; it was established in Xiamen in December 2017 as Xiamen
SigmaStar Technology by SigmaStar Technology Inc., a wholly owned
subsidiary of MStar Semiconductor (Taiwan), which became a MediaTek
subsidiary in 2014; it was renamed SigmaStar Technology Ltd. in June
2021 and its A shares have traded on the Shenzhen ChiNext market since
March 28, 2024 [2]. Its listing document says it ranked first globally
in 2021 by shipments of IPC, NVR and USB video-conferencing camera
SoCs, and first in China for 1080p-and-above dashcam SoCs [2]. The IEEE
registry lists blocks to Sigmastar Technology Ltd. in Xiamen and to
Xiamen Sigmastar Technology Ltd. [1].

A MAC in a SigmaStar block is most likely a camera or recorder built on
its SoC rather than a SigmaStar-branded product. Its SSC33x camera SoCs
use one or two Cortex-A7 cores, most are pin compatible with HiSilicon
Hi3516 and Hi3518 parts, the SSC336D/Q list a 10/100 Ethernet MAC and
PHY, and an SSC337DE is used in a Foscam SPC camera [3].

No radio is documented for SigmaStar parts by the sources consulted,
and no FCC grantee code or advisory is listed. Randomization is not
documented.
